assumptions: only scope-matched conflict explanations may block
falsifier: Compiled constraints do not reduce fully-costed verified search versus strongest parent, any valid state/solution is falsely pruned, or a non-refutation/stale/out-of-scope failure acquires pruning authority.
hard_gate_obligations: CANNOT_CHECK and failed attempts never prune
minimal_counterexamples: timeout/failed attempt incorrectly compiled as impossibility
nogood valid in one context reused after a changed assumption
over-generalized conflict prunes a valid solution
too-specific nogood has no search benefit
conflict analysis costs more than repeated search
two failures share symptoms but not the same logical conflict
stale learned constraint after operator/verifier revision
novelty_residual: Evidence-governed compilation of verified RAKL failures into scoped executable pruning constraints beyond descriptive memory, measured against classical nogood-learning parents.
object_description: Compile a machine-verified scoped conflict/refutation into a reusable pruning constraint/nogood for future solver states, while keeping ordinary failed attempts as non-blocking warning memory.
oracle_or_lower_bound: In finite known worlds enumerate the exact infeasible assignments/states and minimum sound conflict sets. A compiled constraint is licensed only if every state it prunes is independently verified impossible under the exact registered scope; otherwise pruning authority is invalid.
permitted_publication_claim: Scoped solver-search/failure-learning result only; compiled constraint authority is limited to verified operational/logical impossibility in its registered scope and grants no scientific authority.
qoi: Paired verified search reduction and repeated-failure avoidance versus descriptive failure memory and modern nogood-learning parents, with zero false pruning outside the exact licensed scope.
same_system_ablation: Same problems with descriptive failure memory only, CDCL/nogood parent, and the scoped Orion compilation candidate.

strongest_parents.justification: Current Orion failure memory warns/reroutes but does not compile active pruning constraints.
Canonical conflict-driven learned-constraint parent for propositional known worlds.
Direct state-space/reachability parent for learning dead-end constraints rather than SAT-only clauses.
Small-world oracle for minimum sound conflict/nogood and maximum legitimate pruning.

total_cost_equation: candidate_total = conflict_extraction + conflict_verification + constraint_storage/retrieval + reduced_search + final_verification
